headline: Broad participation. Quarter breadth expanding. Load up on the best setups.
trading_action_detail: Broad participation. Multiple timeframes aligned. Qullamaggie: 'If the market is going up, if stocks are going up, your job is to be long, okay?' Run your full scan tonight. Focus on leaders breaking out of tight bases.
scan_guidance:

coach_note: Good conditions. Stay long, stay focused. Qullamaggie's advice: 'The big moves in stocks take weeks and months to develop.' In a bull environment, your job is to find the leaders and ride them. Don't overthink it. Brad Gilbert's rule: Play the percentages. Take your best setups. Don't force trades that aren't there. The market is giving you green lights — walk through them, don't run.
mental_anchor: Process over outcome. Take your setups. Let the market do the work.
mental_reset:
Before you open your scanner, take 60 seconds.
Close your eyes. Breathe in slowly from your diaphragm — count to 4. Hold for 2. Exhale for 6.
Let go of today's P&L. Let go of yesterday's loss. Let go of the trade you should have taken.
You are entering this session with a clear mind and a clear process.
The breadth is bullish. Your job is simple: find the best setups and execute.
Open your eyes. You are ready.
trend_stage_detail: LATE BULL — Trend is aging. Freshness ratio at 0.20 (below 0.25) means fewer new stocks are joining the move — the same leaders are carrying the index. Euphoria at 0.36 — 118 stocks are up 50%+ in a month, which means leaders are getting extended and parabolic. Qullamaggie: 'When everything has already moved, the easy money is gone.' Be very selective. Only the tightest, freshest bases. Tighten stops on existing winners.
scan_quality_detail: Monthly momentum at 3.5x. Good scan environment. Focus on stocks that have moved 15-25%+ in the last month and are consolidating. Look for tight, orderly bases — the kind where the stock is 'resting' not 'breaking down'. ADR% > 3.5%, Dollar Vol > $25M. Be patient with entries — wait for the pivot.
